title: Disc Tissue RNA Extraction
author: Joesph B Lesnak
materials: If in RNAlater place in 4°C refrigerator overnight
Discard the flow through and collection tube.

steps.title: Collect and freeze disc tissue
steps.instruction: Isolate nucleus pulposus (NP) and annulus fibrosus (AF) tissue, then either freeze immediately on powdered dry ice or place the tissue in a 5 mL tube containing 4 mL RNAlater; the next day remove tissue from RNAlater and freeze again on powdered dry ice, then store in a new tube at –80 °C.

steps.title: Weigh tissue and prechill tubes
steps.instruction: Remove the frozen tissue, cut off a section, place it in a 1.5 mL tube on dry ice, measure the weight (preferably < 100 mg, especially for AF samples), and pre‑chill all subsequent tubes to keep the tissue as frozen as possible.

steps.title: Pulverize frozen tissue
steps.instruction: Place tissue pieces in a Corvaris TT2 bag, keep the bag on dry ice until ready, dip the bag into liquid nitrogen and impact with the Corvaris device until a powder forms, moving the frozen debris around after each impact to ensure thorough pulverization.

steps.title: Lyse powder with Qiazol
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Qiazol to the bag, retrieve the frozen pulverized sample, and transfer it back into the 1.5 mL tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL chloroform to the tube, shake for 15 seconds, incubate 2 minutes at room temperature, then centrifuge at 4 °C, 12 000 g for 10 minutes; collect the upper aqueous phase into a new micro‑fuge tube.
Repeat the above with another 200 µL chloroform on the collected aqueous phase, shake, incubate, centrifuge, and transfer the upper phase to a new tube.
Repeat a third time with 200 µL chloroform, shake, incubate, centrifuge, and collect the final aqueous phase.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add the same volume of 70 % RNase‑free ethanol as the aqueous phase (approximately 300–400 µL), mix gently to precipitate RNA.

steps.title: Load sample onto RNeasy column
steps.instruction: Load 700 µL of the ethanol‑mixed sample onto an RNeasy spin column, centrifuge for 15 seconds at > 8 000 g at room temperature; repeat loading steps until the entire sample has passed through the column.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer RW1
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL Buffer RW1 to the spin column and centrifuge 15 seconds at > 8 000 g at room temperature.

steps.title: First DNase on‑column treatment
steps.instruction: Prepare a DNase mix by adding 70 µL Buffer RDD (kept in the fridge) to 10 µL Qiagen DNase (stored at –20 °C); add the total 80 µL directly onto the column, incubate 15 minutes at room temperature, then add 350 µL Buffer RW1 and centrifuge 15 seconds at > 8 000 g at room temperature.

steps.title: Second DNase on‑column treatment
steps.instruction: Repeat the DNase cleanup: mix 70 µL Buffer RDD with 10 µL Qiagen DNase, add the 80 µL to the column, incubate 15 minutes at room temperature, then wash with 350 µL Buffer RW1 and centrifuge 15 seconds at > 8 000 g at room temperature.

steps.title: RPE washes
steps.instruction: Wash the column twice with Buffer RPE:

substeps.instruction: Pipette 500 µL Buffer RPE onto the column, centrifuge 15 seconds at > 8 000 g at room temperature.
Pipette a second 500 µL Buffer RPE, centrifuge for 2 minutes at > 8 000 rpm at room temperature.

steps.title: Dry column
steps.instruction: Transfer the RNeasy column to a new 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge for 1 minute at full speed (≈ 16 000 g) at room temperature to dry the membrane.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a 1.5 mL collection tube, add 15 µL RNase‑free water, incubate 1 minute, then centrifuge > 8 000 g for 15 seconds at room temperature; add the same 15 µL water from the collection tube back onto the column, incubate 1 minute, and centrifuge > 8 000 g for 1 minute at room temperature to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Quantify RNA with Qubit
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration using a Qubit fluorometer: prepare working reagent (200 µL per tube, one tube per sample, two tubes for standards, using 200× stock at room temperature while the rest stays at 4 °C), prepare standards (10 µL low standard + 190 µL working reagent; 10 µL high standard + 190 µL working reagent), prepare samples (1–5 µL RNA + 199–195 µL working reagent), vortex each tube and read on the Qubit instrument.
